title: MP High Court Assistant Grade III Online Form 2026
qualification: Graduation / computer typing as per MP High Court notice
ageLimit: As published in the official notification
applicationFee: As published in the official notification
selectionProcess: Online application → Written exam / CBT / PET as notified → Document verification → Final merit
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mphc.gov.in
2. Open the latest advertisement for MP High Court Assistant Grade III Online Form 2026
3. Register or log in and fill the application
4. Upload photo, signature and required documents, then pay the fee if applicable
5. Submit and print the confirmation page
shortDescription: MP High Court Assistant Grade III Online Form 2026. See the official notice at mphc.gov.in.
content:
High Court of Madhya Pradesh has published an update for Assistant Grade-III. Confirm the current eligibility, fee and dates in the linked notice.

How to apply

  1. Open mphc.gov.in
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
